questions.solution:

__
 
• ''**If two subjects are joined by expressions like** 'along with, **as well as**, in addition to, besides, nothing, unlike, like, no less than etc.' **the verb that follows agrees with the first subject**".
 
• For Examples:-
 
 
• Rohan** as well as** his friends **is **playing.
 
• They **along with** their teacher **are **going on vacations.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the verb must agree with the **first subject** i.e. **Supriya**.
 
• The singular form of the verb i.e. **has **should be used.
 
• On the other hand,** 'on'** will be used because it means **in the course of (a journey).**
 
 
• For Example - He was **on **his way to see his mother.
 
 
 
• Thus, **'has gone on**' will be used instead of** 'have gone of'.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
